title: Common-Neighbor Conjecture for Generalized Saxl Graphs
clean_statement: Let $G$ be a finite primitive permutation group on $\Omega$ with base size $b(G)\geq2$. Form the generalized Saxl graph $\Sigma(G)$ on $\Omega$ by joining two vertices when they lie in a base of size $b(G)$. Must every two vertices of $\Sigma(G)$ have a common neighbor?
source_citation: Computational Group Theory (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/27, pp. 1389--1450
source_location: Printed p.1406, Conjecture 1; original PDF page18
current_status: Already counterexampled in September2026 preprint; exact finite instance independently verified 2026-10-03
